text: I CAN'T SEE THE WORD THE AND LOOK AT A DOUBLE LETTER TOO.
THE FATAL DOSE WAS IN THE CHAMPAGNE.
HE THREATENED TO EXPOSE US ALL.
HE CHANGED THE WILL BEFORE THE GALA.
A COMPARTMENT BEHIND THE RED SAILBOAT.
THE GIRL IS STILL BREATHING.
BOUGHT HER A ONE WAY TICKET UPSTATE.
HIDING THE NINETEEN TWENTY THREE VOYAGES.
THE CUBAN SILK IS LIQUID GOLD.
SEND MY HALF TO THE PLAZA.
PAY THE CLINIC OR SHE WALKS.
THE BIRD FLEW THE COOP ON SUNDAY.
HEAVY DOSES OF MORPHINE ORDERED BY STERLING.
ARTHUR GIVES THE ORDERS NOW.
THE OLD MAN PLANTED THE BOOTLEGGING LEDGER AS A TRAP.
A WOMAN IN THE LOCKED STUDY.
SOMEONE LOCKED THE DEADBOLT FROM THE HALLWAY.
THE WIDOW IS HER TRUE BIOLOGICAL MOTHER.
CLARA VOWED TO EXPOSE HER OWN MOTHER.
THE KILLER LEANS ON CARVED SILVER.
A DEEP VOICE COAXED THE VICTIM TO DRINK.
BUYING MUSCLE FROM THE EAST SIDE BOYS.
THE KILLER LEANED ON A HOLLOW SILVER CANE.
THE WALKING STICK WAS A CONCEALED FLASK.
TRACES OF BITTER ALMONDS IN THE GLASS TUBE.
THE WARD WAS DRAGGED OUT IN POLICE HANDCUFFS.
CITY HALL SIGNED THE WARRANT FOR HER ABDUCTION.
THE GREEDY SNITCH SANK TO THE BOTTOM OF THE RIVER.
THE SMUGGLED RIFLES WENT TO MUNICIPAL ARMORIES.
THE TYCOON HELD THE POLITICIAN BY THE THROAT.
THE TOP COP TAKES A CUT OF THE SMUGGLING.
THE BADGES ARE BOUGHT AND PAID FOR.
THE EXECUTION IS SCHEDULED FOR MIDNIGHT AT PIER FORTY FOUR.
A CROOKED STAR LEFT BLEEDING ON THE DOCKS.
ARTHUR NEVER STEPPED FOOT IN THE STUDY.
A PAIR OF WOLVES LOCKED FROM THE INSIDE.
THE SHADOW SPOKE WITH A CLINICAL TONE.
A TRAVEL ALIAS PROVES HE WAS AT THE GALA.
HE SUPPLIED THE CYANIDE FOR HER PLOT.
THE GUILTY BIRDS ARE FLYING SOUTH.
THE MURDERERS ARE NOT ON THAT BOAT.
THE RUMOR PROMISED OFFSHORE GOLD AT THE DOCKS.
HEAVY ARTILLERY IS COMING IN THE FOG.
THE WIDOW BROUGHT LEAD INSTEAD OF LAWYERS.
SHE SLAUGHTERED THE DOCTOR TO KEEP ALL THE LOOT.
USING THE MOTHER AS A HUMAN SHIELD.
ARTHUR KEPT THE APOTHECARY RECEIPT FOR BLACKMAIL.
LET THE FEDS SWEEP UP THE BODIES.
THE SYNDICATE ACCOUNTS ARE STILL BURIED.
THE WIFE SERVED THE DEADLY VINTAGE.
A SIGNED CONFESSION PINS THE MASTERMIND.
OFFERING BLOOD MONEY FOR CLEMENCY.
THE OFFSHORE VAULT BELONGS TO THE DAUGHTER.
THE BOOTLEGGING LEDGER SEALS THEIR FATE.
A GUILTY VERDICT DEMANDS THE ELECTRIC CHAIR.
THE PATENTS AND SHIPS WERE SIGNED OVER YEARS AGO.
THE OLD MAN ENGINEERED HIS OWN REVENGE.
PURGING THE SYNDICATE FROM THE MANIFESTS.
CLARA BURNED THE FINAL BLACKMAIL LEDGER IN THE FURNACE.
A GOLD WATCH BOUGHT WITH BLOOD AND BRASS.
CLARA BOARDED A STEAMSHIP FOR PARIS UNDER A FALSE NAME.
